title: Tech view: labor rate columns and fields are hidden on work order lines
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with View mode set to Tech view and See Financial Data ON.
custom_steps:
1. Open a work order and look at the line columns.
  2. Look for any labor rate column or field.
custom_expected: Labor rate columns and fields are hidden, even though See Financial Data is on — the hiding comes from Tech view, not from See Financial Data.
evidence: UI: with a tech-view role that also has See Financial Data ON (ZZAUTOTEST TechSFD), the WO lines screen SHOWS the Rate ($100), Margin, Total columns and labor $150 — labor rate is NOT hidden by tech view. With plain Technician (SFD off) money+rate are hidden. So labor-rate visibility follows See Financial Data, contradicting the case premise that tech view hides labor rate even when SFD is on. (Caveat for dev: the test role also had Work Orders Create&Edit.) screenshot techview-sfd-lines.
